note: Resolves differences found by dual-stack-sweep.py. category_defaults override the script's built-in defaults (TEXT_ONLY/JAVA_UNHANDLED_500/JAVA_RAW_HTTP_4XX accepted; RUST_FAILS_WHERE_JAVA_OK/RUST_OTHER_CODE fail the run; the rest are OPEN backlog). An override must name the endpoint, may narrow by variant/category, and must say why the difference is acceptable.

overrides.note: State artefact, not a Rust defect: TheoryKnowledgeTestService.getByKnowledgeSwfIdAndEnable returns ResponseResult.error("数据异常") when no test exists, exactly like Rust. The probe's Java 200 comes from a test row that Java's own earlier probe write created for swf id 999999 (Rust rejects that write with 202, see RUST_STRICTER).
Rust hardening required by the migration plan (section 4.3): the user entity carries no deviceId, password or token. Java returns deviceId and the SHA-256 token digest in userEntity.
